Hi Samira / Devon,

- Cost target: average token cost < $0.0025 for the bulk workload.
- Functional: consistent structured JSON outputs for the invoice-parsing prompt set (see attached sample test cases).
- Security: API keys must be scoped to the trial workspace; SSO for 3 named engineers; audit logging enabled.

- Week 0 (this week): credentialing and SSO invites; IP allowlist; temporary API keys provisioned. Owner: Prism infra (you) + Redwood onboarding (Marissa).
- Week 1: ingest test dataset + run baseline throughput/latency tests. Owner: Prism engineering + Redwood performance team.
- Week 2: iterate prompts and quantization profile; validate cost & quality. Owner: Prism ML lead + Redwood solutions.

Immediate asks (can you confirm these by EOD tomorrow?):
1) Provide a short allowlist of IP prefixes (CIDR) for your test runners so we can add them to our firewall.
2) List 3 SSO invite emails for engineers to be added to the trial workspace (SAML/Okta).
3) Confirm if you need persistent API keys for CI (we can provide short-lived keys otherwise).

Attachments: sample-test-cases.csv (see attached) and draft success criteria workbook.

I'll loop Marissa and Ben into the thread to handle the provisioning and hit the timeline.

Thanks,
Aditya
